label: corpus-garbage-purge-codestral
prompt:
Write /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/scripts/lucidota_corpus_garbage_purge.py — deletes base64 garbage from lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk in batches.

Requirements:
- DB: psycopg3, connect via os.environ.get('LUCIDOTA_GO_STORAGE_DSN', 'postgresql:///lucidota_storage')
- Garbage = content matches regex '^[A-Za-z0-9+/\n\r]{60,}={0,2}$' (pure base64 block with no real words)
- Delete in batches of 5000 using: DELETE FROM lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk WHERE chunk_uuid IN (SELECT chunk_uuid FROM lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk WHERE content ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/\n\r]{60,}={0,2}$' LIMIT 5000)
- Loop until 0 rows deleted
- Print progress: 'Purged {batch_deleted} this batch, {total_purged} total...' every batch
- Before deleting: run a COUNT query and print 'Found {n} garbage chunks to purge'
- After all batches done: run VACUUM ANALYZE lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk (with autocommit=True connection)
- Write receipt at /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/05_OUTPUTS/receipts/corpus_garbage_purge_{timestamp}.json: {purged_count, remaining_count, duration_s, timestamp_utc}
- Require --confirm flag to delete; without it print the count only
- Imports: argparse, json, os, sys, time, re from pathlib import Path from datetime import datetime, timezone import psycopg

label: c-archive-email-stream
prompt:
Write /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/scripts/lucidota_c_archive_email_stream.py — streams through C_ARCHIVE.zip in-memory, parses emails with proper MIME extraction, inserts clean text to corpus_chunk, then DELETES the source zip.

Context:
- C_ARCHIVE.zip is at /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/KRAMPUSCHEWING/C_ARCHIVE.zip (7.9GB)
- It contains nested zips (Inbox-2020.zip, Inbox-2021.zip, Sent-2019.zip etc.) inside ARCHIVE/CORPUS/COOP_DETAT/Very English Coop d'Etat/
- Also contains non-email archives under ARCHIVE/ARCHIVE/ (INSTALLERS, MEDIA, DOCUMENTS, CODE, etc.)
- DB: lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk, insert: (chunk_uuid UUID, file_uuid NULL, sha256 TEXT, source_path TEXT, mime TEXT, chunk_index INT, content TEXT, go25 JSONB DEFAULT '{}', embedding NULL, embedding_model NULL, extractor TEXT)
- chunk_uuid = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, sha256 + source_path + str(chunk_index))
- sha256 = hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()

Algorithm:
1. Open outer zip in streaming mode (zipfile.ZipFile on file path, no full extract)
2. For each entry in outer zip:
   a. If it ends with .zip: open it as nested zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(outer_zip.read(entry_name)))
      - For each entry in nested zip:
        - If .eml or .txt (or no extension, likely eml): parse with email.message_from_bytes()
          * Extract text/plain parts ONLY using part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
          * If text/plain empty, try text/html and strip tags with re.sub('<[^>]+>', '', html)
          * Build: f'Subject: {msg['Subject']}\nFrom: {msg['From']}\nDate: {msg['Date']}\n\n{body}'
          * SKIP if result < 50 chars or if it still looks like base64 (>60% non-space non-alpha chars)
          * Chunk at 1800 chars, insert to corpus_chunk
          * source_path = f'C_ARCHIVE.zip!{entry_name}!{nested_entry_name}'
          * mime = 'message/rfc822', extractor = 'c_archive_email_stream_v1'
        - If .txt or .md or .json: read as text, chunk at 1800, insert
        - Otherwise: skip
   b. If it's _ORGANIZE_MANIFEST.json or _QUARANTINE_PURGED_MANIFEST.json: read as text, insert as single chunk
   c. Skip binary/image/video entries
3. Print progress every 1000 emails: 'Processed {n} entries, {chunks} chunks inserted'
4. After ALL entries processed successfully: write receipt at /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/05_OUTPUTS/receipts/c_archive_email_stream_{ts}.json with {entries_processed, chunks_inserted, duration_s, zip_deleted}
5. After receipt written: DELETE /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/KRAMPUSCHEWING/C_ARCHIVE.zip using os.remove()
6. Print 'C_ARCHIVE.zip deleted after successful ingestion'
7. DB connect: psycopg3, os.environ.get('LUCIDOTA_GO_STORAGE_DSN', 'postgresql:///lucidota_storage'), autocommit=False, commit every 500 inserts
8. Imports: argparse, email, email.policy, hashlib, io, json, os, re, sys, time, zipfile from pathlib import Path from uuid import uuid5, NAMESPACE_URL from datetime import datetime, timezone import psycopg
9. CLI: --dry-run (no insert, no delete, just count), --skip-delete (ingest but dont delete zip)

label: krampus-zip-extractor
prompt:
Read /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/scripts/corpus_groq_extractor.py for the write_chunk pattern and corpus_chunk schema.

Write /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/scripts/lucidota_krampus_zip_extractor.py — processes KRAMPUSCHEWING zip archives one at a time: unpack to temp dir, ingest all extractable text, delete temp dir, delete original zip.

Context:
- KRAMPUSCHEWING dir: /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/KRAMPUSCHEWING/
- Temp unpack dir: /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/09_STORAGE/krampuschewing_unpacked/ (create if missing)
- Disk MUST stay under 82% (check before each archive and after each cleanup)
- DB: lucidota_korpus.corpus_chunk, psycopg3
- Archives to process IN ORDER (skip C_ARCHIVE.zip — handled by separate script): docs_Luci-010.zip, docs_NORDLEY_SQUEEZECOPY-001.zip, docs_RICKSHAW_ROBBERY-002.zip, docs_PHONE_BACKUP_MOTOGPLAY_20260415-011.zip, Lucidota.zip, NorthernStrike_ZIPPED_EVERYTHING_ELSE_20260508T0005-20260515T114241Z-3-003.zip, NorthernStrike_ZIPPED_EVERYTHING_ELSE_20260508T0005-20260515T114241Z-3-004.zip, NorthernStrike_ZIPPED_EVERYTHING_ELSE_20260508T0005-20260515T114241Z-3-006.zip, NorthernStrike_ZIPPED_EVERYTHING_ELSE_20260508T0005-20260515T114241Z-3-008.zip, Luci.zip, Screenshots.zip, mfspx_Pictures-009.zip, retry_mfspx_dot_claude_key_state.zip, NORTHERN_STRIKE-20260515T035215Z-3-001.zip, meta-2026-Mar-23-23-17-05-20260515T034652Z-3-001.zip, FIXME-20260515T034630Z-3-001.zip, RICKSHAW_ROBBERY-20260514T060139Z-3-001.zip

For each archive:
1. check_disk_pct() using shutil.disk_usage('/'); if >82%: STOP all processing, print 'DISK LIMIT ABORT'
2. Check if archive already processed: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM corpus_chunk WHERE source_path LIKE '{archive_name}!%' — if >20: print 'already ingested, deleting zip' then DELETE the zip
3. Create temp dir: 09_STORAGE/krampuschewing_unpacked/{archive_stem}_{timestamp}/
4. Extract zip to temp dir using zipfile.ZipFile.extractall() (handle zip64)
5. Walk all extracted files recursively:
   - TEXT_EXT = {.txt, .md, .py, .js, .ts, .json, .jsonl, .sql, .csv, .xml, .html, .htm, .yaml, .yml, .log, .conf, .ini, .toml, .sh, .bat, .rst}: read utf-8 errors=replace, chunk at 1800 chars, insert
   - EML_EXT = {.eml}: parse with email module, extract text/plain only, skip base64 attachments, chunk 1800, insert
   - SKIP: .pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .odt (will be handled by OCR pipeline), .zip (nested), images, video, binary
6. After all files inserted: write receipt at 05_OUTPUTS/receipts/krampus_extract_{archive_name}_{ts}.json with {archive, files_extracted, chunks_inserted, skipped_files, duration_s}
7. Delete temp dir: shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)
8. Delete original zip: os.remove(KRAMPUSCHEWING/archive_name) — ALWAYS delete after successful receipt
9. check_disk_pct() after deletion and print disk% improvement
10. source_path format: '{archive_name}!{relative_path_inside}'
11. extractor = 'krampus_zip_extractor_v1'
12. ON CONFLICT (chunk_uuid) DO NOTHING for all inserts
13. Commit every 1000 inserts

CLI: --archive NAME (process only this one), --dry-run, --max-pct 82, --skip-delete (dont delete zip)
Print progress: 'Archive: {name} | Files: {n} | Chunks: {m} | Disk: {pct}%' after each archive

prompt:

- Do NOT delete PDF/DOCX files after ingestion — they are legal documents
